notes.title: Repair part of the air wall, change the gun bug
notes.notes:
update:

1. Loading the map will prompt the player not to respond or the screen is black. Don't click the mouse. Wait 1-2 minutes to get in.

2. Fix the bug that the air wall of some maps will fall down

3. Fixed the bug of picking up two bullets with the same weapon. Now you can't pick up the same weapon. Will give a hint

4. Resolution adjustment is added, which is 1080p, 2K, 4K resolution selection

5. Fixed the vertical synchronization setting

6. Fixed bug that the image quality adjustment could not save
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39536865/f7a92a639bb044f213092b82ec808408be84338e.png[/img]

notes.title: 修复了部分空气墙，换枪BUG
notes.notes:
更新：
1.加载地图会提示玩家未响应或黑屏不要点鼠标，等1-2分钟进去。
2.修复了部分地图的空气墙会掉下去的BUG
3.修复了相同武器拾取两把会卡子弹BUG，现在不能拾取相同武器了。会给出提示
4.增加了分辨率调整，分别是1080p,2k,4k分辨率选择
5.修复了垂直同步设定
6.修复了画质调整不能保存的BUG

notes.title: Fixed some problems
notes.notes:
The method of loading and reading scenes has been modified, which may be helpful to the problem of black screen. The loading level will read the progress bar. When the progress bar is full, it will be able to go in for a while.

If the screen is still black or not responding, then Then I'm trying to find a way

Fixed 2-3 appreciation errors



Increased mouse sensitivity settings, you can only enter the level to select settings to change

Added vertical synchronization settings, you can only enter the level to choose settings to change, and each time after adjusting the quality must be reset.





Other problems should be fixed step by step.
